name: Narendra Nath Kushwaha
bio: Narendra Nath Kushwaha holds a PhD from the Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli and a Post-Doctoral Fellowship from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore. His research interests lie in the areas of Auditing and Corporate Governance. Before joining academia, he worked with the Bank of New York Mellon, Pune.
